context:
Goal: keep the global CLAUDE.md small, with each rule loading where it must act.
Problem (rule): the audit moves one Building rule to a path-scoped rule, and nothing moves without your sign-off.
Based on (ruling): your 12:38 and 12:40 CST Nov 11 words on moving sections, "it would need my sign off".
Based on (measured): the plan's word counts, and its load test: a rule that stops an act must load before that act.
Departs from: main — guards-need-incidents (95 words) moves to a rule that loads only for hooks/** and lint/**.
Meanwhile: nothing moves before your answer; the guard test file split this waited on is done (merged 07:16 CST Nov 12).
Re-checked 11:39 CST Nov 12: the quoted text is unchanged. Correction: the 95 words are two rules. Guards-need-incidents (47 words) is about building guards and fits a hooks/lint rule file. Mistake-names-its-guard (48 words) applies to any mistake in any repo at report time, so a hooks/lint rule file would not load for it. The real question: move only the 47 words, or both?

options.how: The lane moves the text as the plan proposes.
options.label: Accept the move
options.lose: The rule loads only once a session reads a hook or lint file.

options.gain: The rule loads in every session, before any act.
options.label: Keep it global
options.lose: No words leave the global file.

reply: Recorded 12:00 CST: the move is accepted. Sent to lane global-claude-md-scope-audit, with the re-check's note that only the 47-word guards-need-incidents rule fits a hooks and lint rule file.
title: Where guards-need-incidents lives
why: The lane's pick: the rule acts only while writing a guard or check, in those folders.
